topic: Hum social media wali life ko apni life se kyun compare karte hain?
audience: Urdu-speaking young adults using social media
objective: Make viewers recognize curated highlight reels and return attention to their own progress.
visual_direction: Cinematic 9:16; fictional protagonist; color arc indigo/teal → saturated coral/fuchsia/cyan feed → cool comparison blue → warm amber reset → golden/coral close. Animated color wash and independent motion layers change continuously frame by frame.
constraints: No user likeness or photo used.
No caption pills, active-word strips, logos, social handles or generic end card.
No claim that all social posts are fabricated.
